left.raw_text: Symptomatic paroxysmal AF who had at least one AF episode electrocardiographically documented within one (1) year prior to enrollment. Documentation may include electrocardiogram (ECG); Transtelephonic monitoring (TTM), Holter monitor or telemetry strip
Failed at least one antiarrhythmic drug (AAD) (Class I or III antiarrhythmic drugs) as evidenced by recurrent symptomatic AF, or intolerable to the AAD
Able and willing to comply with all pre-, post-, and follow-up testing and requirements
